text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Monday.
- Belgrade is fearing the demilitarisation of Eastern Slavonia according to a commentary by military analyst Fran Visnar.
- The Inter-Continental Hotel in Zagreb has been named the chain's European number one by the Inter-Continental Hotels Corporation (IHC).
- Croatia's central bank has put the country's foreign debt at $4.8 billion.
- Privatisation of agricultural land: Farmers - owners of land to pay 1,500 kuna fine for each hectare of the land they have not cultivated.
- The renowned Spanish opera singer Montserrat Caballe and her daughter Montserrat Marti to stage concerts in Zagreb in April and in Pula in August.
- The War Vetaran's Association of Herceg-Bosna is expressing concern over the arrest of Mladen Naletilic-Tuta. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
